visualTrial.purpose: Apply the same proposed visual-explanation criteria to both requested topics. Neither topic nor scene is a reference exemplar or approval standard.

alternatives.representation: Sequential day cards versus simultaneous calendars
alternatives.reason: Shows which date is equal across two references and where each today lies.

alternatives.representation: Truth verdict cards alone versus connected worlds with quantified truth tokens
alternatives.reason: Exposes a witness, a counterexample, and the counted range before the verdict.

visualTrial.review: Separately assess scientific correspondence, visual inference, craft/readability, interaction and rendered bounds. Tests do not certify comprehension or visual quality.
